description: The mapping from `service.json` template id → component-library scenario lives in ui-health's `service.json` (not hardcoded in code), so new frameworks plug in via configuration.

requirements.description: The mapping from a scenario's `service.json` template ID to its corresponding component-library scenario must be defined in ui-health's own `service.json` configuration, not hardcoded in application code. Adding support for a new framework must require only a configuration change, not a code change.
requirements.title: Data-Driven Framework Dispatch Resolver

validation.notes: Framework dispatcher reads the template-id-to-scenario mapping from ui-health service.json at startup
Dispatcher returns the correct component-library scenario name for the `react-vite` template ID
Dispatcher returns a structured error for an unrecognized template ID
No component-library scenario name is hardcoded as a string literal in dispatch logic
Add a new framework mapping entry to service.json and confirm the dispatcher routes to the new scenario without code changes
Remove an existing mapping entry and confirm the dispatcher returns an appropriate error for that template ID
The platform can adopt new UI frameworks (Vue, Svelte, etc.) without requiring a ui-health code release

title: Framework dispatch resolver is data-driven
